headline: Inter Ikea Sales Drop as Group Cuts Prices to Revive Growth
summary: Inter Ikea reported a drop in sales as the brand owner cut prices to revive growth, warning that consumer weakness and geopolitical turmoil will weigh on future results.
why: Inter Ikea is the brand owner and franchiser for the global Ikea home furnishing network, serving as a bellwether for global retail demand.

impacts.name: Inter Ikea
impacts.why: Inter Ikea is reporting declining sales and price-cut strategies.
